title: glyph: A Grammar of Interactive Graphics — glyph-package
text: glyph's design draws directly ideas prior art others: Leland Wilkinson's Grammar Graphics — layered data/mark/scale vocabulary glyph's spec structured around. ggplot2 — aesthetic-mapping model (aes(), bare names instead) pipeline style building plot layers. Vega-Lite — idea declarative, serializable JSON spec compiles render tree, treating interactions selections. ggvis — earlier reactive, D3-backed grammar graphics R; glyph's D3-via-htmlwidgets rendering follows path. ggiraph — ggplot2 output D3-powered tooltips, hover, selection; direct influence glyph's tooltip/hover/brush model. plotly — baseline "interactive R plot" offer (zoom, pan, tooltips), glyph aims provide natively. patchwork — model glyph's compose() multi-plot layout API. gganimate — transition_states()-style keyframe grammar behind animate(= ..., transition = "morph"). ggExtra — marginal histogram/density/boxplot pattern behind marginals(). ggrepel — inspiration mark_text(smart_repel = TRUE)'s label decluttering (glyph uses simpler iterative pairwise-nudge approach rather ggrepel's force simulation — see mark_text()). package also bundles D3.js (Copyright Mike Bostock, ISC License); see inst/COPYRIGHTS full notice.

title: glyph (development version)
text: Plots now fit inside container directions (#17). plot drawn spec’s width height (600 x 400 unless set) scaled container’s width, wide, short container RStudio’s Viewer pane came taller space available x axis cut . happened facet() grids, also overflowed narrow containers, plots R Markdown documents ran past 400px box text . Plots facet grids now drawn size container , redrawn resized. New statistical marks (#6): mark_boxplot(), mark_violin(), mark_sina() mark_histogram(). statistics computed R plot compiled, stats::quantile(), stats::density() hist()-style bins, computed mappings evaluated rows missing values dropped. work facet() (summaries computed per panel), compose(), theme tokens, tooltips (show statistics), hover, click brushing. box, violin bin knows rows summarises, brushing points linked panels highlights boxes bins contain selected rows, brushing box selects rows. Brushing zooming now apply whole plot rather point mark separately. plot several brushable marks gets one brush covers , interact(zoom = TRUE) now zooms plots point mark. Points categorical x axis now drawn middle category instead left edge. quantitative axis now spans values every mark plot, just first, second mark wider range longer cut . Automatic tooltips show computed mapping expression (e.g. factor(cyl)) instead internal column name, tooltip templates can refer fields whose names contain dots, {.median}. Plots layouts now draw automatically R Markdown, Quarto vignettes, without ending pipeline render() (#13). glyph registers knit_print() methods glyph_spec glyph_layout; knitr stays suggested package. Printing compose() layout console now draws , single plot, text description used print available new summary.glyph_layout(). render() still setting width height. Rewrote README, pkgdown home page, ARCHITECTURE.md Getting Started vignette plainer language (#4). Removed comparisons ggplot2 documentation, including comparison tables README “glyph vs ggplot2” vignette. package Title Description now describe glyph (#5). help pages longer compare glyph packages either, several now describe code accurately. ?glyph longer claims lists, URLs Arrow tables accepted data, ?facet longer says panels get independent scales default, ?marks ?interactivity drop features don’t exist (#5). export() .html longer fails machines without pandoc (#3). Instead low-level pandoc error, now writes HTML JavaScript <name>_files folder alongside, says , including get single self-contained file (install pandoc, run inside RStudio). pandoc requirement now documented ?export. Fixed entrance/slide animation bar charts showing bars Safari Chrome mobile (#2). animation reading value never set already zeroed , bars always animated zero height; now stores bar’s real height/position animating. Made plots responsive: SVG now scales fill container (via viewBox) instead fixed 600px width, theme background now always covers full plot area. Previously dark theme’s background didn’t reach edges narrower wider containers, including mobile. Added reset-zoom control, made double-tap reset zoom instead always zooming , zoomed-plot can zoomed back touch devices. Tooltips now also appear tap dismiss tapping elsewhere, touch devices hover state. Brush selection now also clears tap outside plot, just -drag tap inside . Fixed tapping/clicking point nothing brush tooltip/click interactions enabled mark: brush’s full-plot overlay sits top marks (drag can start anywhere) swallowing tap reached point underneath. Fixed problem continuous mouse hover: hovering point nothing (tooltip, hover effect) whenever brush also enabled mark, reason tap fix . Brushing still works dragging anywhere plot area. Fixed one drag panning brushing zoom brush enabled mark: zoom binds drag <svg> brush overlay inside , single mousedown started gestures. drag now one thing time — brushes default brushing available, small toggle next reset-zoom control (shown enabled) switches dragging selecting panning. scroll wheel, trackpad pinch, two-finger pinch double-click/double-tap always zoom, whichever mode toggle . Two-finger pinch-zoom now works plots also brush enabled. d3-brush stops propagation every touch move one-finger gesture starts, second finger never reached zoom behavior; pinch now handled anything can intercept . Fixed plot jumping axis-margin offset first time zoomed panned — zoom transform replaced plot group’s existing margin translate instead composing . Clicking reset-zoom control longer discards brush selection. Tapping plot’s margin (inside chart outside plot area) now clears brush selection, tapping outside widget already . Double-tap zoom/reset touch longer depends d3-zoom’s internal gesture detection, also makes work repeated double-taps dragging set brushing. Computed aesthetic mappings (e.g. x = log(wt), color = factor(cyl)) now evaluated compile time instead silently dropped; expression text used default axis/legend label. Rows NA mapped position aesthetic (x, y, x2, y2, y_min, y_max) now dropped mark compile time, warning reporting many rows removed aesthetic(s), similar ggplot2. facet(rows =, cols =) now accepts computed expression (e.g. facet(cols = factor(cyl))), evaluated way aesthetic mapping — previously raw expression text used literal (nonexistent) column name, faceting anything plain column silently produced single, unlabeled facet. Faceted panels now use mark’s resolved data — computed mapping columns NA-dropped rows included — instead unfiltered slice shared data, facet() combined computed mapping NA values now behaves unfaceted case. Removed auto-selection “canvas” “webgl” rendering engine data size compile() — renderer ever existed, D3/SVG renderer , “selection” never anything. compile(engine = ...) now accepts "auto"/"html" errors values instead silently accepting . Removed remaining claims WebGL/Canvas rendering standalone static SVG export package description, documentation, README, ARCHITECTURE.md; Canvas renderer planned future release. Added Mike Bostock Authors@R inst/COPYRIGHTS credit bundled D3.js library (ISC license), per CRAN policy bundled JavaScript. Added “Acknowledgements” section README glyph-package help page, crediting prior art glyph’s design draws . Documented mark_text(smart_repel = TRUE)’s actual method (iterative pairwise nudging overlapping label boxes) instead leaving unspecified, credited ggrepel inspiration. title: glyph 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-06 Initial CRAN release. Core spec builder quosure-based aesthetic mappings (aes() required). Eight mark types: mark_point(), mark_line(), mark_bar(), mark_area(), mark_text(), mark_rule(), mark_ribbon(), mark_link(). First-class interactivity via interact(): tooltips, zoom, brush selection, hover effects, cross-filtering, named selections. Declarative animation via animate(): entrance transitions keyframe animation data states. Unified scale system via scale() convenience wrappers scale_color(), scale_log(), scale_time(). Token-based theming via theme_tokens() five built-presets: light, dark, minimal, publication, presentation. Built-layout composition via compose(), marginals(), inset(), facet(). Compilation pipeline via compile(), rendering interactive HTML widgets via D3.js. JSON spec export via export() Vega-Lite interoperability via to_vegalite(). D3.js v7 rendering engine via ‘htmlwidgets’.
